name: Rapicut Carbides Ltd
tagline: BSE: 500360 | NSE: RAPICUT | Microcap tungsten carbide manufacturer, Ankleshwar, Gujarat
business_overview: Rapicut Carbides Ltd (incorporated 1977, commercial production since 1979) manufactures tungsten carbide products - tips, inserts, wire-drawing nibs, bar/tube drawing pellets, rings, flats, bushes, jute eyelets and tool-room products - used in metal cutting, mining, and wear-part applications. In 2019 the company was acquired by Abhishek Gami, promoter of United Wolfram, bringing in fresh professional management with direct exposure to the tungsten supply chain.

sentiment_summary: The dedicated ValuePickr thread ('Rapicut Carbides Ltd. - A micro cap with potential!') dates to 2016 and saw a large 2019 shift after the Gami/United Wolfram acquisition. It has re-activated sharply in August 2026 around a 'tungsten supercycle' narrative - China production quota cuts, rising defense/semiconductor/AI-driven demand, and forecasts of a ~20,000 MTU global tungsten deficit by 2028. A specific governance flag raised in the thread: ~Rs 28.5 Cr of purchases are related-party transactions with parent United Wolfram, and year-end inventory looked elevated - posters explicitly called for volume (not just price) verification before treating the results as clean. No dedicated X/Twitter thread activity beyond general commodity/tungsten-price commentary was found in this pass; sentiment there tracks the same tungsten-supercycle narrative rather than anything Rapicut-specific.
